summary.en: Protect your life first. Call 119 for fire, injury or sudden illness, and 110 for crimes and accidents (within Japan). Nagoya City issues evacuation information; the Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) issues weather warnings. This app does not judge the current danger, give evacuation orders, or tell you whether a shelter is open. Check the latest official information.
